title: Adopt the game-kit contract for state, actions, and rules
context: Implement the shared `game-kit` contract so Logic Grid exposes one deterministic

spec.summary: Adopt the game-kit contract for state, actions, and rules
spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Illegal actions return `None` and never panic.
Replaying the same seed and actions produces identical state.
A conformance test covers initial state, legal actions, and apply.
No browser dependency is added to the core crate.
Map the Logic Grid rules to the traits.
Same seed + actions = same state hash.
